controlled_first_attempt:
set -e
source /aigc/engineering/fuping.chu/env/codex_env.sh
unset RANK WORLD_SIZE LOCAL_RANK LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE GROUP_RANK ROLE_RANK ROLE_WORLD_SIZE MASTER_ADDR MASTER_PORT TORCHELASTIC_RUN_ID
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=GPU-a147b765-e023-7bbd-8576-1c11032a9f05
export PATH=/aigc/engineering/fuping.chu/agent_projects/official-h200-r01/source/.venv/bin:$PATH
TASK_ROOT=/aigc/engineering/fuping.chu/agent_projects/official-h200-agent-r01
TASK_OUT=$TASK_ROOT/acceptance-h200-r02
exec 9>/aigc/engineering/fuping.chu/agent_projects/GPU-a147b765-e023-7bbd-8576-1c11032a9f05.lock
flock -n 9

python -c 'import subprocess
g="GPU-a147b765-e023-7bbd-8576-1c11032a9f05"
a=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid","--format=csv,noheader"],text=True)
m=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--id="+g,"--query-gpu=memory.used","--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],text=True)
assert g not in a and int(m.strip())<=100,(a,m)
print("GPU idle",g)' > "$TASK_OUT/controlled-preflight.log"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$TASK_OUT/cache" TMPDIR="$TASK_OUT/tmp"
nvidia-smi --id="$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES" --query-compute-apps=timestamp,gpu_uuid,pid --format=csv -l 1 > "$TASK_OUT/controlled-occupancy.log" 2>&1 &
TASK_MONITOR=$!
trap 'kill "$TASK_MONITOR" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for TASK_SPEC in matmul_3:candidate matmul_3:compile flash_attention_7:candidate flash_attention_7:compile; do
 TASK_NAME=${TASK_SPEC%:*}
 TASK_VARIANT=${TASK_SPEC#*:}
 TASK_LABEL="$TASK_NAME-ncu-controlled-$TASK_VARIANT"
 TASK_LAUNCHES=1
 if [ "$TASK_NAME:$TASK_VARIANT" = "flash_attention_7:compile" ]; then TASK_LAUNCHES=3; fi
 if timeout 300 ncu --target-processes all --profile-from-start off --nvtx --nvtx-include "$TASK_VARIANT/" --launch-count "$TASK_LAUNCHES" --cache-control all --clock-control base --section SpeedOfLight --section LaunchStats --section ComputeWorkloadAnalysis --section MemoryWorkloadAnalysis --section MemoryWorkloadAnalysis_Tables --section Occupancy --section SchedulerStats --section WarpStateStats --metrics dram__bytes_read.sum,dram__bytes_write.sum,lts__t_bytes.sum --export "$TASK_OUT/$TASK_LABEL" python /aigc/engineering/fuping.chu/agent_projects/autokernel-control-h200-r01/experiments/wan/autonomous/accept_official_candidate.py --candidate "$TASK_ROOT/workspace/workspace/kernel_${TASK_NAME}_optimized.py" --reference-root /aigc/engineering/fuping.chu/agent_projects/official-h200-r01/source --output "$TASK_OUT/$TASK_LABEL-capture" --profile nsys > "$TASK_OUT/$TASK_LABEL.log" 2>&1; then
 echo 0 > "$TASK_OUT/$TASK_LABEL.exit"
 ncu --import "$TASK_OUT/$TASK_LABEL.ncu-rep" --page raw --csv > "$TASK_OUT/$TASK_LABEL.csv" 2>&1
 else echo $? > "$TASK_OUT/$TASK_LABEL.exit"; fi
done
echo DIAGNOSTICS_FINISHED
controlled_first_result: Stopped owned pipeline after it stalled before profiling in a helper process (ldconfig); no kernel counter results. Preserved partial files.
